synthesis.paragraph: Three of today's papers carry the tag "Urban Transport and Accessibility", exploring associations of neighbourhood greenery and walkability with hospital admissions, reviewing international non-binding policies for sustainable land passenger transport in Europe, and assessing wheelchair accessibility in Zurich City Center. Another three papers carry the tag "interview", tracing decisive factors in sustainable stormwater management, analyzing future-oriented practices of care in Gothenburg local initiatives, and examining public comments and interviews regarding emotional support animals. Outside of these groups, one paper presents a bibliometric analysis and systematic review of spatial injustice and inequality in Sub-Saharan Africa from 1981 to 2023. Another study evaluates the environmental readiness of ten major maritime flag States for decarbonization, while a final paper constructs a multidimensional housing quality index to evaluate housing deprivation across Ghana.
